title: bash tool hangs forever when the command backgrounds a job
observed: Command 'go run . >/tmp/api.log 2>&1 & ... curl ...' finished, but the backgrounded subshell held the output pipe; kiln read to EOF and waited 29 min (no default timeout either). Killing the job released it instantly.
expected: The tool returns when the shell exits (background job keeps running), and every command is bounded by a default timeout
